PZZ700-140915-
1239 PM PST Fri Nov 13 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 977 mb low was located 250 nautical miles west of La 
Push, WA, and a 1016 mb high pressure was located 800 nautical 
miles west of Punta Abreojos, Mexico. Southerly winds will
strengthen and turn westerly late this afternoon and continue 
through Saturday morning. Swell and wind waves will increase 
as well tonight into Saturday. Winds and seas slowly diminish 
late Saturday and Sunday, before increasing again on Monday as the
next weather system arrives.

$$

7 ft. Wave Detail: W 6 ft at 6 seconds and S 2 ft at 16 seconds.

.TUE NIGHT...Wind NW 20 to 25 kt...becoming N 10 to 15 kt after

.WED...Wind NE 10 kt in the morning...becoming variable less than
